headline: Costa Rica Opens $13 Million Solar Plant in La Carpio Powered by 21,300 Panels
summary: ICE opened a $13 million solar plant in San Jose featuring 21,300 panels on a former fuel plant site, providing power equivalent to 30,000 homes.
why: Renewable energy infrastructure investments expand national clean energy capacity and affect utility-scale power generation economics.

impacts.name: Costa Rica
impacts.why: New renewable generation capacity boosts clean energy infrastructure.
